pairs: Are you, therefore, alone among men,
and will wisdom die with you?
And I have a heart just as you also do,
and I am not inferior to you.
For who is ignorant of these things,
quis enim hæc quæ nostis ignorat?
He who is mocked by his friends as I am,
invocabit Deum, et exaudiet eum: deridetur enim justi simplicitas.
and he will listen to him because it is the sincerity of the just that is being mocked.
Lampas contempta apud cogitationes divitum parata ad tempus statutum.
The lamp that is despised in the thoughts of the rich is ready for the appointed time.
The tabernacles of robbers are numerous,
and they provoke God boldly; whereas,
cum ipse dederit omnia in manus eorum.
it is he who has given all things into their hands.
and the birds of the sky,
and they will reveal to you.
and it will respond to you,
and the fish of the sea will explain.
Quis ignorat quod omnia hæc manus Domini fecerit?
Who is ignorant that the hand of the Lord has made all these things?
In cujus manu anima omnis viventis,
In his hand is the soul of all the living
and the spirit of all the flesh of mankind.
Does not the ear perceive words,
and in length of days is prudence.
Apud ipsum est sapientia et fortitudo;
With him is wisdom and strength,
there is no one who can build up;
there is no one who can open.
and if he sends them forth,
Apud ipsum est fortitudo et sapientia;
With him is strength and wisdom;
ipse novit et decipientem, et eum qui decipitur.
he knows both the deceiver and he who is deceived.
He leads advisors to a foolish end
He removes the belt of kings
and encircles their waist with a rope.
He leads away priests in dishonor
altering the lips of those who speak the truth
and sweeping away the teaching of the aged.
He pours disdain upon the leaders,
relieving those who had been oppressed.
He reveals the depths of the darkness,
et producit in lucem umbram mortis.
and he brings the shadow of death into the light.
and, having been overthrown, he restores them anew.
Qui immutat cor principum populi terræ,
He transforms the heart of the leaders of the people on earth,
et decipit eos ut frustra incedant per invium:
and misleads those who in vain advance upon the inviolable.
They will grope as in the darkness,
et errare eos faciet quasi ebrios.
and he will make them stagger like drunkards.
